title: GY manual locker-screening artifact (gy.locker-screening.v1)
description: Validation schema for the per-(run_id, pool) screening evidence artifact required by docs/ops/GY-OPS-RB-05.md R7. One artifact is produced per run and pool; the independent reviewer countersignature is mandatory for a qualified PASS (R6/R8).

token_program.description: Token program that owns the LP mint, as determined in R4. Only the SPL Token program (TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA) and the Token-2022 program (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb) are valid; any other token program is unsupported and fails closed (R4 step 6). Must equal token_program_coverage.mint_program (enforced by a top-level conditional).

cluster.description: Exact cluster identity as recorded. For M1 this must be the local Mainnet fork label — never Testnet or Mainnet production.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact inventory data relied upon.

mint_program.description: Token program that owns the LP mint, read from the mint account (R4 step 1). Only the SPL Token program (TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA) and the Token-2022 program (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb) are valid; any other token program is unsupported and fails closed (R4 step 6). Must equal pool.token_program (enforced by a top-level conditional).

mint_program_determination_evidence.description: Evidence recorded for the mint-program determination (R4 step 1).

cross_program_query_result.description: Recorded result of the same mint-filtered query against the other token program. A nonzero account count fails the run (R4 step 3).

handling.description: Recorded per-extension disposition: verification method applied, reconciliation inclusion, or explicit unsupported (fail closed).

token2022_extensions.description: Explicit per-extension record, always present. Must be a non-null array when the LP mint is Token-2022 (possibly empty only when the recorded extension enumeration shows the mint has no extensions) and must be null when the LP mint is SPL Token; enforced by the conditionals below (R4 step 4). Every extension with an unverifiable effect is recorded as unsupported and the run fails closed.

account_validation.description: Recorded statement that every returned token account passed the R4 step 5 checks (owner program, mint, layout, state).

token_lock_evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of each retained TokenLock raw response. Required as a non-null, nonempty array whenever marker_present is true (R2: complete remaining-account evidence); null or omitted only when the marker is absent. Enforced by the conditional below.

filters.description: Exact versioned getProgramAccounts filter objects used. Constrained to the manifest-hashing supported subset (docs/ops/GY-OPS-RB-05.md R7): ASCII property names and values restricted to strings, booleans, integers, null, arrays, and objects — non-integral numbers cannot occur in a canonicalizable artifact.

result.description: Recorded query result, including pagination limitations; an incomplete query cannot support PASS (R3).

enumeration.description: Enumeration method used; full getProgramAccounts enumeration or the weaker getTokenLargestAccounts fallback (which must be labelled weaker, R4).

snapshotter_cross_check.description: Snapshotter custody-reconciliation cross-check (R5); null when the snapshotter has not yet been run for this pool.

disqualifying_evidence.description: Required for disqualifying or fail-closed determinations; null for a qualified PASS.

limitations_acknowledgement.const: Best-effort screening against a ratified inventory — not universal detection.

reviewer.description: Independent reviewer countersignature (R8). Required, non-null, with nonempty identity and signature, for a qualified PASS; enforced by the conditional below.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the deterministic canonical serialization of this artifact with manifest_sha256 itself excluded: RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) — UTF-8, object members sorted recursively by UTF-16 code-unit order of their keys, ECMAScript number serialization, RFC 8785 string escaping. The exact recipe, included fields, supported-subset constraints, and verification procedure are defined in docs/ops/GY-OPS-RB-05.md R7. The schema records the digest but cannot recompute it; reproducibility is verified by the independent reviewer (R8) and by scripts/validate-locker-docs-schemas.py against the committed vectors in docs/ops/manifest-test-vectors.json.

retention_date.description: Retention deadline: certification lifetime plus at least two years.

jcs_safe_object.description: Object restricted to the manifest-hashing supported subset: ASCII (BMP-free) property names and recursively jcs-safe values.

jcs_safe_value.description: JSON value restricted to the manifest-hashing supported subset (docs/ops/GY-OPS-RB-05.md R7): strings, booleans, integers (IEEE 754-exact), null, arrays, and ASCII-keyed objects. Non-integral numbers are excluded so RFC 8785 canonical serialization is unambiguous.

basis.description: Recorded basis. Required for approved_benign_custody (written basis plus owner approval) and for PDA attribution (derivation inputs: program ID and seeds, R4).

derivation_evidence.description: Documented PDA derivation evidence. Ownership data alone does not attribute a PDA (R4).

token_program_coverage.mint_program_determination_evidence: EXAMPLE: mint account owner read via getAccountInfo
token_program_coverage.cross_program_query_result: EXAMPLE: 0 accounts under Token-2022 for this mint; recorded
token_program_coverage.account_validation: EXAMPLE: every returned account passed owner/mint/layout/state checks

generic_custody.enumeration: EXAMPLE: full getProgramAccounts enumeration with mint memcmp filter

examples.limitations_acknowledgement: Best-effort screening against a ratified inventory — not universal detection.
examples.retention_date: EXAMPLE: certification lifetime plus at least 2 years
